questions.stem: What is the correct sequence for urea production and removal from the body?

options.text: Kidneys produce urea, liver filters it, bladder stores it
Kidneys deaminate amino acids, liver converts them to urea, bladder excretes it
Stomach breaks down protein into urea, blood carries it to kidneys
Liver deaminates amino acids to form urea, blood carries it to kidneys, kidneys excrete it in urine

questions.explanation: The liver carries out deamination of excess amino acids to produce urea. The urea then travels in the blood to the kidneys, where it is filtered out and excreted in urine.
